- LESSON (script doctrine): process.exit() inside try skips finally — any probe/fixture script that mutates shared state must compute an exit code and exit OUTSIDE the try/finally. Same class as the r575 overclaim: the record must match the machine, and the machine must match the record, before shipping.

- R1 triage: the paste (upload/Pasted Content_1793332441347.txt, a 149.8KB full-page snapshot) mapped to the four cards; every endpoint probed 200-JSON on the live server (vault, egress/token, egress/routing, egress/status, cron/forensics, gh/vitals at 3.3s, version) - the HTML was intermittent, not path-broken.
